public_rationale: Gemini supplied a substantive consumer LLM application besides ChatGPT before publication. Google documented everyday creation and learning functions and reported more than 400 million monthly active app users. This contradicts the existence claim under the ordinary software-inclusive reading supported by the surrounding sentences.
limitations: Both evidence items are company disclosures.
Existence and use do not establish that the product was excellent or profitable.
A hardware-only or purely evaluative reading would require different criteria.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Despite the media and investor attention and effectively the entire tech industry focusing on large language models, there is still no real consumer product from them other than ChatGPT.

statement.excerpt: Despite all that media and investor attention — despite effectively the entirety of the tech industry focusing on this one specific thing — we're still yet to get any real consumer product.

from_speaker: Despite all that media and investor attention
effectively the entirety of the tech industry focusing on this one specific thing
we're still yet to get any real consumer product
our_interpretation: The preceding sentence supplies the ChatGPT exception, which is preserved here.
Real consumer product means a publicly usable LLM-based product with substantive everyday functions and demonstrated consumer use.
Software applications count because the surrounding passage asks about products from GPT, Gemini and other LLMs and explicitly treats ChatGPT as an exception.
For the ongoing observation, the target is the latest reportable current month through publication: May 1–27, 2025.
The references to attention and industry focus frame the assertion; they do not make it a conditional forecast.
criteria.support_condition: Reliable evidence establishes that no publicly usable consumer LLM product with substantive functions and demonstrated use existed besides ChatGPT during the target period.
criteria.contradiction_condition: At least one publicly usable consumer LLM product besides ChatGPT had substantive everyday functions and demonstrated consumer use during the target period.

evidence.explanation: The disclosed usage establishes that Gemini was an extensively used consumer application before the post. Together with its documented functions, it supplies a counterexample.

evidence.excerpt: interactive infographics, quizzes and even podcast-style Audio Overviews
evidence.explanation: Google documented concrete consumer functions available in the Gemini app. These functions, combined with the usage disclosure, meet the stated ordinary reading of a real consumer product.
